purpose: Authorize continuation of the bounded Local Qwen provider hardening after substantive PR #5347 exact-head review produced a policy-inadmissible speculative finding and the first mechanically same-anchor repair repeated the same speculative hedge. Permit a finite maximum of three repair attempts only for an initial SPECULATIVE_CLAIM that has an exact path/new-side-line/verbatim-evidence anchor, with every repair locked to that same anchor and independently revalidated. Preserve fail-closed behavior, exact-head authority and all model/runtime/policy/transport pins. This authority supersedes the retired implementation branch named by the prior revision of this manifest; it does not authorize product changes or convert provider maintenance into independent review.

The first mechanically same-anchor repair remained on the same path/line/evidence but again used policy-inadmissible speculative wording, so the fail-closed validator correctly rejected it.
No admitted Outbox/product defect exists from that failed review; changing product code to satisfy the rejected speculative claim is forbidden by this authority.
One repair attempt is insufficient for this observed deterministic provider failure mode, but unbounded retries or replacement-finding search would weaken review authority.

requiredChange.summary: Keep the initial full-chunk semantic review unchanged. Every repair must expose only that original line in the trusted eligibility index, retain the full exact chunk only as untrusted context, mechanically restrict any non-empty response to the preserved path/line/evidence tuple, and independently re-run the unchanged policy validator. A different violation fails closed immediately. A third still-invalid repair fails closed with rejected diagnostics.
